item: a catalogue document row may declare its identity, doc_type and translation_kind, so the language versions of one treaty are one identity
key_paths: src/law/declared.py; src/law/lane_sync.py; src/law/model.py; scripts/validate_legal_catalog.py; configs/legal_sources.yml; tests/test_law_declared_identity.py; tests/fixtures/law/synthetic/treaty/
summary: v0.6.0 row C slice S3 (C-L2). A treaty page states no number a parser can read, so each language version was its own local identity keyed on its URL. A documents row may now declare identity {scheme, value} (act-number, e.g. mtdsg:xviii-1), doc_type and translation_kind; lane_sync looks the row up by its own (jurisdiction, url) and records what it states, so six language URLs become one LawIdentity with six tracked documents (original, translations, reader switch, second pass stable). The value is the operator's statement, never derived from the URL; a declaration the model refuses makes the whole row undeclared and fails the validator; a row declaring nothing is recorded as before. Also fixed: ensure_identity and register_document reset a recorded doc_type, translation_kind and translator to nobody-said on every tracking pass. Proven on a SYNTHETIC treaty (six invented bodies in zxx-* tags, .test hosts, no socket): 31 tests, 15 of 16 mutants killed (the survivor is equivalent). NOT done: no live treaty URL, no UN Treaty Collection or WIPO Lex row, no new host or licence token, SECURITY.md and net-hosts.js untouched, live ingestion waits on the operator's verified URLs. Open operator items: six verified URLs of one UN treaty with the robots and licence look; wipolex.wipo.int is not in the 260-host count (261 needs SECURITY.md and net-hosts.js together); no UN or WIPO licence token; WIPO Lex is typed ip so a treaty hosted there is not counted by the C-L1 floor; equally authentic texts have no vocabulary slot.
